column1: # Data: Malaysian quarterly online job-offering observations for Software Developers.
# Source: DOSM Job Market Insights releases for 2026-Q1 and 2026-Q2
# linked in source_url. source_date is the release date; updated_at is review date.
# Used by: src/trend_data.py and src/main.py for the selected career's local
# market panel and comparable consecutive-quarter changes.
# These observations do not change skill trend codes or career ranking.
# job_offerings covers the source's online recruitment sample
# mapping_note explains the occupation match; blank occupation_code is not zero.

column10: Exact occupation title match. Both quarterly releases count online job offerings from major private recruitment platforms; not all Malaysian vacancies. The release does not specify a MASCO code.
